paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range 41--74 $μ\mathrm{eV}$ using Millimeter-Wave Receiver and Radioshielding Box
notes: DOSUE-RR search for dark photon dark matter via metal-plate conversion, 10-18 GHz (41-74 ueV), using room-temperature millimeter-wave receiver in a radioshielding box. No signal found; upper limits chi < (0.5-3.9)e-10 at 95% CL. The paper gives only the range of the limit in text (full limit curve is in Fig. 11, not tabulated), so the two data points encode the quoted min/max chi values across the mass range; the actual frequency dependence of the limit is not captured. The minimum (5e-11) and maximum (3.9e-10) are assigned to the low- and high-mass ends respectively as an approximation, but the exact mass at which each occurs is not stated. Assumed local DM density rho = 0.39 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 2))
